title: A Connected WebSocket Doesn’t Mean Your Crypto Prices Are Fresh
summary:
A crypto dashboard can look healthy while displaying an old price.
The WebSocket is connected. The status indicator is green. The last quote still looks plausible.
But connection status answers only one question: does the transport appear to be available? It does not establish that the application has received recent, valid data for the instrument on screen.
For developers building market dashboards, freshness deserves its own state.
A useful design separates:
Connection state: Is the transport
